A header of view buttons in two groups split by a hairline, the estate's own and the repo-promoted app views (app/index.html:451), over a sidebar beside the main pane (app/index.html:608, 1267). The main pane holds exactly one view at a time, each lazy-mounted behind x-show with its own width cap, so the body is a slot. Proposed new:host: a region that hosts another unit whole, coded on that unit's row. Every view's state is written to the address through the VIEWS table (app/index.html:5557, syncUrl at 6085), so the binding is stamp. Recent files and project links carry source-peek cards (app/index.html:1242). The repo menu is a fixed panel positioned by hand from a row's trailing buttons (app/index.html:1946, style at 5478), the job rowMenu.open({x, y, items}) does. On touch, a horizontal swipe on main steps through estateNav (app/index.html:1268, 7960). Below lg the sidebar is an overlay drawer, closed by default (app/index.html:7806), with its own scrim (app/index.html:586); the header nav scrolls rather than wraps. Coded from the landing and bare estate shots; shell-desk.png and shell-phone.png are the landing render.

Two panes split by the house dock-split handle (stage.js:1164, stage.js:2475): the deposit lens on the left (Out, the send picker, declared inboxes, and the errands when any are open) and the staged set with its Add finder on the right. The split is keyed to the Stage container at 42rem rather than to the window, so a docked deck stacks it as a phone does (stage.js:1126). The frame controls act on the Add pane only: a Browse, Recent, Search switch (stage.js:2032), Recent's single-select repo badges (stage.js:2074) and a filename box (stage.js:2087). An Add row stages its file, which redraws the staged list and the Out bundle. A staged row opens the reader as a deck over the staged set at that position (stage.js:4546); the comparison drills from it (stage.js:4412), as does the transform workbench (stage.js:3400). Flavor pills and staged rows peek through source-peek (stage.js:1819, stage.js:1910). The Recent badge rail is the same control as Search's repo rail, built twice with no kit. Form fileset because the staged list is the set a #stage= link carries. On a phone the panes stack, Out and errands first.

The Stage with its errand panel forced open: &tab=errands calls toggleErrands on mount, and the toggle writes the address back when the panel closes (stage.js:2322, stage.js:3046). The control is one moped button in the Staged header (stage.js:1555), not a strip, as the shell's own comment says (app/index.html:5587); new:panel-toggle names a single button that shows a region of the body and stamps its own address. The panel is a column of errand cards under Out, each a complete account with its own verbs: title, kind, age, venue, script and destination, the script text, a grade line, Run or Copy script, Aim here, and a closing note with Send and close or Decline (stage.js:1406). Aim here sets the Out destination, and ?errand=<id> rings one card (stage.js:1077). Nothing opens over the cards; the rest of the bench is coded on the Stage row. The shots match the Stage's because four stand-in errands are open and show the list anyway; open tints the moped button and adds the empty message and the bookmarklet row (stage.js:1480).

Mounted by estate.js as the Activity row's last pill (lib/alpineComponents/estate.js:3231) and drawn by state-view.js. The Activity query box shows above it and does not reach it. A gallery of five pages listed in docs/tools.csv, with titles and notes joined from pages/pages.csv at load (tools.js:191). Each card has a thumbnail or live switch in its corner, which changes how the card looks rather than what the grid holds, an open link to the hosted page in a new tab, and a source link (tools.js:63). The header's registry chip peeks docs/tools.csv through source-peek (tools.js:48). Four columns at xl, one on a phone. The card is the same hand-built page card as the repo Pages view and the Project Pages tab (app/index.html:1373, app/index.html:1698).

Drawn by estate.js, not by write-kinds.js as the slice's files column suggests: the pane is lib/alpineComponents/estate.js:3462 and the kit only classifies each commit. A line of kind chips with counts is the filter and the census at once (lib/alpineComponents/estate.js:3478), with the cached window stated at its end; a Read 100 per repo button deepens the read (lib/alpineComponents/estate.js:3504). One row per commit (lib/alpineComponents/estate.js:3533): kind icon, short SHA linking to GitHub in a new tab, repo, subject, age. Nothing opens over or beside the list. On a phone the kind chips wrap to three lines and the repo name drops. The scenario carried no commits, so the rows are coded from the template; the frame is from pixels.

The page has no list and no header of its own: init opens kits/file-deck.js over the window on load (approve.html:289) and reopens it whenever it is closed (approve.html:322), so the deck is the body, one request item per slide, landing on the rendered md-diff reading (approve.html:303). The one addition to the kit's header is the green approve circle in its actions slot (approve.html:174). Proposed new:deck-page because no body code covers a page whose first paint is a takeover deck with nothing beneath it, and deck-takeover assumes a list it was opened from. Bare, it shows only the error alert; shot again with an inline #gz= test envelope of two web-tools files, which drew the deck at both widths. On a phone only the deck's slide counter drops.

Areas are columns of grouped link rows, one to four by width (links.html:312), under a strip of rail-pinned items that repeats board entries rather than filtering anything (links.html:289). A row tap leaves for its destination, so the only reach is an area's notes button, which draws that area's dossier full width under all the columns (links.html:436); proposed new:panel-below because it opens neither in place like expand-row nor over the page like a modal. The dossier is rendered by a markdown-lite of its own (links.html:243) where kits/md-doc.js renders markdown. The edit toggle swaps the columns for a form (links.html:385), a mode rather than a frame. Style is Tailwind utilities only, but a portal vocabulary of its own: serif masthead, accent rules per area, small-caps group labels. On a phone the columns stack into one and the rail wraps to four lines. Rendered from the home checkout beside it.

Coded on Ledger: a sticky header holds the Ledger and Sources switch (news.html:315), a search box, a Topic or Date grouping switch, an All, Live, Backfilled switch, and topic and kind pills (news.html:360), over item cards grouped by topic (news.html:405). The pills narrow the list but carry no counts, so count-chips does not fit; proposed new:filter-switch for a chip row, switch or menu whose pick narrows the body without counts. The facet switch is coded tabs though it writes no address (news.html:62). A card title leaves for the source, so nothing opens on the page; the Sources facet is follow toggles with a param editor that expands in place (news.html:479). On a phone the facet labels drop to icons and the sticky header grows to about 315 of 844px, while each group heading is sticky at top-[104px] (news.html:408), the desktop header height, so from the code it would slide under the header there. Rendered from the home checkout.

Opened bare, as the app view is, it lists the proposals read from shortcut-tools proposals/ (shortcut-edit.html:56); a pick replaces the list with that proposal under a back arrow (shortcut-edit.html:260), and a #gz= link from tools/edit.py opens straight there. The proposal view is three numbered handover buttons, a line per change naming its place that scrolls to it without a tint (shortcut-edit.html:398), and the after listing with unchanged blocks folded to an outline that open in place (shortcut-edit.html:394). One-line rows grouped by day and by sitting (shortcut-log.html:70) beside the picked row's facts, side by side above a 48rem container (shortcut-log.html:66). The header's All, Installs, Runs, Behind select narrows the rows and shows no counts (shortcut-log.html:54), hence new:filter-switch, and a button in the detail filters to one name (shortcut-log.html:144). A daisyUI table of chains whose headers neither sort nor filter, so list rather than grid (shortcuts.html:120), under a name filter and a select of device states with no counts (shortcuts.html:105). A chain name swaps the table for that chain's own view and writes ?name= by pushState (shortcuts.html:389), so a link reopens it: install and run buttons, Calls and Called by chips, and the action listing, whose references scroll to their line and tint it for 1.4s (shortcuts.html:497), the job kits/land.js does. On a phone the Cards and Build columns drop, their values moving under the name (shortcuts.html:425), and action labels become icons. The Device column fills only with a token; shot both ways and on ?name=.

Coded on Probes, the default pane: pill tabs written to ?pane= (text-lab.html:905), standing chips with counts and a concept select (text-lab.html:961), and probes grouped by date that open in place to their fields (text-lab.html:1088). One switch away, Variants rows are md-diff pairs with a foot line whose comment and info buttons open a pinned panel-tip (text-lab.html:634) and whose cards glyph opens the filtered list as a takeover deck at that row (text-lab.html:676). Variant pairs did not render headless, and the variants deck opened with its header and foot only.

Guide over files (branch-brief.js:415): the guide is about the branch, not an index into its files, so no selection binding. The same component is each slide of the Branches deck, so the branch form appears at ring 0 and at ring 3. Shot since 2026-10-05 at a #gh= address, where headless it finds no commits and draws the guide and the files empty; on a phone the guide stays over the files, as at desktop width, which is all the phone code rests on.

One block per row of dimensions.csv, two to a row at @5xl (map.js:3571). Each block is an item group: its header, held at the top of the pane, names the dimension, how many of its codes are in use and whether a unit takes one or any (map.js:3578), with what the dimension holds and its test under it (map.js:3590). Each code is an item: its name, a bar for its share of the units in scope and a count, opening in place to its gloss, test, kit and units (map.js:3595); a unit opens the deck at itself over the units coded with it (map.js:3627), docked beside the list on a wide screen. The scope chips carry counts and narrow every bar (map.js:3545). By dimension and Table draw the same units two ways, the table one row per unit and one column per dimension, so the switch is recorded here and not coded (map.js:3555). A block's Gallery button and a code's shots link go to the Gallery grouped by that dimension (map.js:3585, map.js:3633), a change of subview rather than a reach. Declares a List whose item groups are the dimensions and whose items are the codes. Without a token it reads this repo's units only and says the budget-drs units need one.

The coded units' shots as cards, in one section per code of the dimension Group by picks (map.js:3721). Each section's header is an item group held at the top of the pane, its badge reading the section's size in flow and n / m while held (map.js:3827, patTrack at map.js:7385). A card is the Pages gallery's card: the shot, then a tinted footer with the unit's kind, name, check seal, address and app (map.js:3889). The scope chips carry counts and narrow every section (map.js:3727); the jump row under them scrolls to a section and hides nothing (map.js:3751). A card opens the deck at itself over its section (map.js:7787), each slide drawn from the unit's codes (patSlide, map.js:7615); docked, the deck rings its card in the list and scrolls it under the held header as it swipes (map.js:7848), which with the card's tap makes the tie two-way. Group by and the Desktop and Phone switch (map.js:3737) change how the same units are arranged and which shot they show, so neither is coded. Below 42rem of pane, on a phone or beside a docked deck, the cards run one to a row and a strip under the held header names the current card (map.js:3774). Declares a Card grid whose item groups are the sections, whose items are the cards, and whose shots are the items' bodies (map.js:3808).

The workspace's declared landing page, whole, in a frame under the pill row (app/index.html:1578), served through pages/toss-render.html at the ref in view (projectLandingUrl, app/index.html:4603).
